# WingsForShare

> Digital solutions agency in Bangalore, India. Builds websites, ecommerce stores, mobile apps, custom software, SaaS products and business intelligence dashboards, with technical SEO, analytics and paid media delivered by the same team.

## Key facts
- Legal name: WingsForShare Digital Solutions
- Location: 15, A.K Max Layout, Kuduregere, Bangalore 562162, Karnataka, India
- Contact: info@wingsforshare.com · +91 86187 64541 · WhatsApp +91 86187 64541
- Hours: Mon–Sat, 10:00–19:00 IST
- Service regions: India, United States, United Kingdom, Australia, United Arab Emirates
- Engagement models: fixed-scope project, monthly retainer, dedicated team
- Pricing bands (2026, INR): landing page ₹8,000–₹25,000; business website ₹25,000–₹1,00,000; ecommerce or web application ₹1,00,000–₹5,00,000; custom platform, SaaS or BI system ₹5,00,000+

## Services
- [Web Development](https://wingsforshare.com/services/web-development/): Custom, SEO-ready websites and web apps built on React and Next.js.
- [SEO Services](https://wingsforshare.com/services/seo/): Technical SEO, content and authority work tied to qualified demand.
- [Ecommerce](https://wingsforshare.com/services/ecommerce/): Storefronts, catalog SEO and checkout that survives peak traffic.
- [App Development](https://wingsforshare.com/services/app-development/): iOS, Android and cross-platform apps with a back end that scales.
- [Custom Software](https://wingsforshare.com/services/custom-software/): Bespoke platforms, portals and internal tools you fully own.
- [SaaS Development](https://wingsforshare.com/services/saas-development/): Multi-tenant products with billing, roles and analytics from day one.
- [Business Analytics](https://wingsforshare.com/services/business-analytics/): Dashboards and reporting that give you one trustworthy number.
- [Digital Transformation](https://wingsforshare.com/services/digital-transformation/): Modernise legacy systems, automate manual work, cut operating drag.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://wingsforshare.com/services/social-media-marketing/): Content and paid social that creates demand before the search happens.

## Work
- [Architecture Portfolio Website](https://wingsforshare.com/work/architect-portfolio/): A project-led portfolio that puts drawings, photography and process front and centre — and turns a quiet studio site into an enquiry channel.
- [Vastra — Garment Ecommerce Store](https://wingsforshare.com/work/garment-ecommerce/): A clothing store where size, fit and fabric are answered on the product page — the three questions that decide whether a first-time buyer checks out.
- [Pest Management Business Intelligence System](https://wingsforshare.com/work/pest-management-bi/): A service business running on paper job cards and WhatsApp moved dispatch, invoicing and reporting into a single operational system.
- [Wings Attendance — Workforce & Field Tracking App](https://wingsforshare.com/work/attendance-app/): Attendance, field location, teams and daily reporting in one app — built for businesses whose staff do not sit at a desk.
- [Digital Business vCard](https://wingsforshare.com/work/digital-vcard/): A web-based digital card that shares instantly, works offline and turns a handshake into a stored contact with context.
- [GardenWalla Nursery Store](https://wingsforshare.com/work/gardenwalla-nursery/): A plant nursery moved its catalog online with category browsing, seasonal collections and an ordering flow simple enough for first-time buyers.
- [Green Nest — Refurbished Electronics Store](https://wingsforshare.com/work/green-nest-electronics/): Refurbished electronics are a trust problem before they are a price problem. The store is built to answer condition, warranty and return questions on the product page.
